description: Upload media to an ad account. Use paths for local disk media, files[].url for public URLs or Google Drive file links, or driveFolderUrl for a public Drive folder. URL and Drive modes return a background jobId to poll with ads_get_upload. Base64 is only for a couple of small images; presigned mode is only for byte-capable environments. In presigned mode, script:true is recommended for agents with a shell.

batchId.description: Optional existing batch ID for grouping with an earlier upload.

cwd.description: Optional base directory for resolving relative paths.

driveFolderUrl.description: Public Google Drive folder share link for server-side background ingestion.

files.description: Public media URLs (including Drive file links), small inline images, or presigned metadata.

base64.description: Base64-encoded bytes for a couple of small images only.

contentType.description: Media MIME type such as image/jpeg or video/mp4.

name.description: Required for base64 or presigned mode. Not accepted with url — the filename always comes from the remote source.

size.description: Optional declared URL size; required for presigned mode.

thumbnailFor.description: Video filename this thumbnail should attach to. If omitted, *_thumbnail names are matched automatically.

url.description: Public HTTPS media URL. Google Drive links are detected automatically.

inlineScript.description: With script:true, return uploadScript inline for clients that cannot fetch scriptUrl.

paths.description: Local files or directories to upload when running the local stdio server. Relative paths resolve from cwd.

presigned.description: Only for environments that can PUT bytes themselves. Large files may return multipart part URLs.

script.description: With presigned:true, return a short-lived scriptUrl and minimal file metadata. Recommended for agents with a shell; use inlineScript:true if downloads are unavailable.

name: ads_upload
title: Upload Media
